description: This file contains driver code for the KSZ8xxx Ethernet switch chips, including register read/write functions, switch setup, workarounds for specific hardware issues, and integration with Zephyr's network and device APIs.

methods.name: dsa_hw_init
methods.description: Initializes the KSZ8xxx switch hardware, including reset, probing, switch setup, and applying workarounds.

methods.name: dsa_delayed_work
methods.description: Periodically checks link status on switch ports and updates network carrier status.

methods.name: dsa_port_init
methods.description: Initializes a DSA port by calling hardware init.

methods.name: dsa_ksz8xxx_sw_write_reg
methods.description: Writes a value to a switch register via SPI.

methods.name: dsa_ksz8xxx_sw_read_reg
methods.description: Reads a value from a switch register via SPI.

methods.name: dsa_ksz8xxx_set_mac_table_entry
methods.description: Sets a MAC address table entry in the switch.

methods.name: dsa_ksz8xxx_get_mac_table_entry
methods.description: Retrieves a MAC address table entry from the switch.
